data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 asserts an 'integrates' relation but does not establish integration of the two cited principles; it states a composite criterion (verdict causally sensitive to decorrelated input, operationalized as execution ablation) yet gives no substantive synthesis showing how the two sources combine rather than merely being co-stated. The refutation clause about gameability does not rescue the claim that integration obtains; it only describes a failure mode. Thus the relation is a summary of the endpoints rather than a genuine integration.
